evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep skips entirely into confirmation of details with 'So basically I would just like to go ahead and confirm the details that you've entered online.' No time-boxed framing or promise of a dependable quote, no wait for a yes.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moves straight into confirming address details without asking 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (second floor apartment vs. three story townhome), floor/stories, number of rooms (two bedroom), walking distance (long walk from truck to apartment, direct access to townhome), additional items (garage storage, balcony items, office setup), access concerns (stairs, gate entry, garage access). Full furniture inventory walk-through provided by customer.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: 'a typical two bedroom apartment usually has 25 to 35 so do you feel like you will fall within that range' — asked, customer declines boxes.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Not offered. Rep does not ask 'Would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Typical range provided: 'a typical two bedroom apartment usually takes three and a half to five and a half hours' + personalized: 'since you are moving from a second floor apartment with stairs access in a very long walk going to a three story to townhome then I would estimate your move to be around or to be between five and a half to six and a half hours. So it's safe to budget around $1,122 to $1,326.'
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Hourly rate ($204/hour for two movers), 26-foot truck, everything included (fuel, taxes, insurance, pads, tools), no hidden fees stated explicitly, two and a half hour minimum, fifteen-minute increments after minimum all covered. However, no trip fee / overnight fee disclosure (not applicable to this call) and no 'not a guess' commitment framing in recognizable form.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Never asked. Rep moves directly to the explicit ask without gauging reaction to pricing.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: 'we have this on time guarantee. So if we can't make it in the time window that we arrange we immediately start discounting money of your. Your final bill' — discount terms present and recognizable.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: 'we have extra perks that you will have access to such as the no worries damage coverage. And it's part of the early rate. We provide up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for accidental damages.' Covers the $2,000 and that it's built into the rate. Does not explicitly state 'no deductible / no fine print' framing.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. Rep does not ask a version of 'Does that put those to rest?' The Two Promises section is delivered as informational preamble before the ask; no confirmation that concerns are resolved.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Rep says 'Alright, perfect. So now Ryan for your personalized estimate...' then directly to the ask. No genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?' or 'any questions?' variant.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' variant.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: 'So having that said would you like our help with your upcoming move on Monday October 5th.' Asked plainly with no built-in out.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Not mentioned. No statement of 'This rate is locked in' or equivalent.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Date confirmed (Monday October 5th), phone number not confirmed, arrival window not confirmed, crew size not confirmed, addresses confirmed (8749 South Western Boulevard → 1910 Hope Street, Dallas, Texas), notes for crew not captured. 2 of 6 items confirmed fully.

top_strength: Rep gathered comprehensive logistics details through a structured walkthrough, captured the full furniture inventory and access constraints, and delivered a personalized estimate anchored to the home size with transparent pricing and both key promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) fully explained.
coaching_note: Open the call with the quid pro quo framing ('10–15 minutes, walk away with a dependable quote, does that sound good?') and ask Their Agenda ('Other than price, what are your biggest concerns?') before diving into address confirmations — this establishes permission and uncovers the customer's real priorities early.
